def run(args, timeout=90):
    p=subprocess.run(args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, universal_newlines=True, timeout=timeout)
    return {'command':args,'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}

def quantile(vals,p):
    vals=sorted(vals)
    if not vals:
        return None
    i=(len(vals)-1)*p
    lo=int(math.floor(i));hi=int(math.ceil(i))
    return vals[lo]+(vals[hi]-vals[lo])*(i-lo)

def summarize(rows):
    o={'count':len(rows)}
    for metric in ['publication_queue_residence_ms','publish_total_ms']:
        vals=[r[metric] for r in rows if r.get(metric) is not None]
        o[metric]={'n':len(vals),'p50':quantile(vals,0.5),'p95':quantile(vals,0.95),'max':max(vals) if vals else None}
    return o

for short in ['rolling-cache-sink-a','rolling-cache-sink-b']:
    container='video-analytics-midterm-'+short
    result=run(['docker','logs','--timestamps','--since',window_30m_start,'--until',window_end,container])
    lines=(result['stdout']+'\n'+result['stderr']).splitlines()
    rows=[]
    timestamped=[]
    for line in lines:
        match=re.match(r'(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:\.\d+)?Z)\s',line)
        timestamp=match.group(1) if match else None
        if timestamp:
            timestamped.append(timestamp)
        if 'segment published' not in line:
            continue
        row={'timestamp_utc':timestamp,'raw':line}
        for metric in ['publication_queue_residence_ms','publish_total_ms']:
            match=re.search(r'\b'+metric+r'=([^\s]+)',line)
            value=match.group(1) if match else None
            try:
                row[metric]=float(value)
            except (ValueError,TypeError):
                row[metric]=None
        match=re.search(r'\bsource=([^\s]+)',line)
        row['source_id']=match.group(1) if match else None
        rows.append(row)
    buckets={}
    for seconds in [30,60]:
        groups={}
        for row in rows:
            if not row['timestamp_utc']:
                continue
            # Docker RFC3339Nano has more fractional digits than Python 3.7 accepts.
            date_text=re.sub(r'(\.\d{6})\d+Z$',r'\1+00:00',row['timestamp_utc']).replace('Z','+00:00')
            ts=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(date_text).timestamp()
            key=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(math.floor(ts/seconds)*seconds,UTC).isoformat()
            groups.setdefault(key,[]).append(row)
        buckets[str(seconds)]=[dict({'bucket_start_utc':k},**summarize(v)) for k,v in sorted(groups.items())]
